# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Prefers compact, content-width action buttons instead of long full-width buttons in the referral UI.
- Use 'Customer-to-Customer' capitalization throughout the application's UI.
- For referral submissions, show the standard thank-you confirmation inside the same open popup rather than automatically closing it and displaying a demo-account banner.
- Do not display “Sharing available” or “Sharing unavailable” status badges in the referral portal; keep the funded-file eligibility restriction.
- Customer sharing must use the signed-in customer automatically without a referring-customer dropdown (admin selection remains). Sharing does not require a funded file for now; retain completed-onboarding and active-code checks.
